channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Dow closes 600 points lower in back-to-back losses as oil prices gain: Live updates
item.description: Wall Street is keeping tabs on the Middle East war and rising trade tensions between Canada and the U.S.

item.title: U.S. downplays Iran's seizure of unmanned sub in Hormuz Strait
item.description: The U.S. and Iran traded new attacks around the Strait of Hormuz, as President Donald Trump insists oil prices will drop fast once the Iran war ends.

item.title: Bombardier points out U.S. footprint after Trump says aerospace giant must build in America
item.description: Trump's announcement comes on the eve of Canadian retaliatory tariffs set to take effect Tuesday on $20 billion of U.S. goods.

item.title: New Hampshire goes to the polls in primary for key open Senate seat
item.description: Incumbent Sen. Jeanne Shaheen, D-N.H., will retire when her term ends in January.

item.title: U.S. sanctions Iranian airlines in aim to tighten economic squeeze as war spreads, oil rises
item.description: The latest U.S. action under "Operation Economic Outcast" targets all Iranian airlines that were not already facing sanctions.

item.title: These dividend stocks could catch a tailwind from data center pushback
item.description: The backlash against artificial intelligence data centers could prove a tailwind for real estate investment trusts in the sector.

item.description: The Freedom Capital Markets chief market strategist is watching Nvidia and Broadcom to see where the S&P 500 could go next.

item.description: Meta unveiled its Muse personal agent app that comes in a free tier or a monthly subscription costing $20 or $100 depending on usage.

item.title: Why the Fed's interest rate call could come down to a few hundredths of a percentage point
item.description: As markets vacillate between which way they see policymakers leaning, all eyes will turn to economic reports measuring producer and consumer prices.

item.title: 'Patients pay the tariff': Swiss pharma CEO warns of Trump's generic drug tariff threat

item.description: Todd Gordon looks through the charts on the DRAM ETF as well as the broader tech sector.

item.title: Chinese giants Xiaomi, Huawei race to get ahead of Apple’s rumored foldable iPhone

item.title: AstraZeneca's COPD drug scores two late-stage trial wins as full data boosts blockbuster hopes
item.description: The full data reinforces hopes that the drug could be a breakthrough COPD treatment and reach AstraZeneca's peak annual sales forecast of more than $5 billion.

item.title: Visa tells CNBC it is expanding data offering for blockchain lenders as demand for stablecoin-linked cards surges
item.description: Visa is doubling down on blockchain-powered financial services with a new program to help issuers of stablecoin-linked cards access loans.

item.title: Here’s where rental demand is heading and what it means for future home sales
item.description: As U.S. rent prices rise, more tenants are relocating to cheaper markets, according to a new report by Zillow.

item.title: Balance transfer cards aren’t for everyone. Here are 3 other ways you can manage debt

item.title: The U.S. is trying to reduce its reliance on China for batteries. Here's what it's up against

item.title: UK announces new Israeli settlement sanctions, despite U.S. warning of economic consequences

item.title: GE Aerospace to spend nearly $12 billion to bring key castings supplier in-house

item.title: Iran Foreign Ministry takes aim at Canada for support of U.S. actions in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Canada had condemned Iran’s "destabilizing actions" in the Middle East, saying that it would work with partners to maintain significant pressure on Iran.

item.title: EverBank to combine with WaFd in $3.9 billion reverse merger

item.title: Pharma major Novartis falls 10% after three drug trial setbacks

item.title: RBC says this fast casual stock down 50% from its highs is set to rise
